title: Page 343
transc:
Washington Jan. 24 - 1865
Geo D. Sheldon 
Ft Monroe Va.
Harriet paradise Webster vincent Animal weaseler Nevada
wilby at appian in addy or peach 
with wafers please order her tooths vernon 
immed'y after they have landed also all
otter see going wayworn vessels that may
reach Animal during the next plaster or
plague days yoke rucker another for polkaer
Lynch ship saint lawrence famish wreathe received
no torpedoes torch kind you name are
nutmegs audit will take months to prepare
them zebra besides the Bureau does not 
know for what purpose these are intended
zodiac will not the walpole torpedoes on
hand or there on board the stromboli
on those sent saxon ordnance yard answer
Sugar youth H a wise Chief Bureau
T. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe Jan. 24 - 1865
Maj. Eckert
Washington
Farmer to Buxton unity The saugus left this morning
for grapes zebra John needs her at once zodiac
she must be now half way zebra No use
for me to send for her ditto will you
let a message meet her and turner back Berrien
Geo. D. Sheldon
